ValidationRule.description: Stage change not allowed for LM profile where Account Status Lead or Status Inactive
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = 'Monster - Sales Ops/LM', TEXT( Account__r.Lead_Account_Status__c ) = 'Inactive', OR( TEXT( Account__r.AccountStatus__c ) = 'Lead', TEXT( Account__r.AccountStatus__c ) = 'Unpromoted' ), ISCHANGED( Stage__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stage change not allowed for Account Status Lead/ Unpromoted and Status Inactive
